title: Smoky Brazilian Yautia Skewers
description: A garlicky and shaggy Brazilian dish featuring yautia, perfect for a date night, with a smoky char-grill flavor, and no onion or garlic for a friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, lemon juice, and chili flakes.
Add the cubed yautia to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated yautia onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking and grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Check for doneness by inserting a fork, which should slide in easily.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
